u01.proof:
by
  intro G g a x y e
  have hx := MethodUse.left_factor g a x (g.mul a y) e
  have hy := MethodUse.left_factor g a y (g.mul a y) rfl
  exact hx.trans hy.symm
u01.bridge: Reduce both terms with the common left factor; the two resulting equalities have a common right side.

u02.proof:
by
  intro G g a x c e
  exact MethodUse.left_factor g a x c e.symm
u02.bridge: Reverse the given equality before applying the common reduction lemma.

u03.proof:
by
  intro G g a b x y e
  have hx := MethodUse.left_factor g a (g.mul b x) (g.mul a (g.mul b y)) e
  have hy := MethodUse.left_factor g a (g.mul b y) (g.mul a (g.mul b y)) rfl
  have inner := hx.trans hy.symm
  have hx' := MethodUse.left_factor g b x (g.mul b y) inner
  have hy' := MethodUse.left_factor g b y (g.mul b y) rfl
  exact hx'.trans hy'.symm
u03.bridge: Reduce the outer left factor, then reduce the inner left factor.

u04.proof:
by
  intro X H h f hf a x y e
  apply hf x y
  have hx := MethodUse.left_factor h a (f x) (h.mul a (f y)) e
  have hy := MethodUse.left_factor h a (f y) (h.mul a (f y)) rfl
  exact hx.trans hy.symm
u04.bridge: Group reduction establishes equality of images; the explicitly supplied injectivity condition recovers equality of arguments.
